name: Soul Pocus
effect:
[Main] Your opponent chooses one:
- Trash 1 card from the top of your opponent's Life cards.
- Add 1 card from the top of your deck to the top of your Life cards.

official_faq.question: If I activate this [Main] effect and my opponent chooses "• Trash 1 card from the top of your opponent's Life cards.", which player's Life card is trashed?
official_faq.answer: The card at the top of the Life cards of the player who did not activate this [Main] effect is trashed.

official_faq.question: If I activate this [Main] effect and my opponent chooses "• Add 1 card from the top of your deck to the top of your Life cards.", which player adds a card to their Life cards?
official_faq.answer: The card at the top of the deck of the player who activated this [Main] effect is added to the top of that player's Life cards.

official_faq.question: I activated this [Main] effect when my opponent had 0 Life cards. Can my opponent choose "• Trash 1 card from the top of your opponent's Life cards."?
official_faq.answer: Yes, they can. In this case, nothing will happen because there is no Life card that can be trashed.

official_faq.question: I have 1 Life card and take 2 damage from my opponent's [Double Attack]. This is the Life card I check for the first damage and I activate its [Trigger]. In this case, does adding 1 card to my Life cards according to this [Trigger] occur before processing the second damage of the [Double Attack]?
official_faq.answer: Yes. You will activate the [Trigger] before the second damage, add a card to your Life cards, and then process the second damage.
